visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pedestrian traffic light in a rural setting turns green. The background features traditional Japanese houses, utility poles, and distant mountains under a pale sunset sky. (2) The camera pans right to reveal vibrant red spider lilies blooming in thick clusters along a paved road and a white metal guardrail, surrounded by lush green foliage. (3) A series of close-up and medium shots highlight the delicate, thread-like petals of the red lilies growing in various spots, including tall grass and near old wooden fences. (4) The flowers are shown near a narrow, flowing stream with dark water, adding a natural element to the landscape. (5) Several white spider lilies are shown growing in domestic plastic garden pots arranged against a wall. (6) A man in a grey sleeveless shirt and black shorts is seen squatting in a field to pick one of the long-stemmed red flowers. (7) He walks away from the flower field toward a railroad crossing with its signature yellow and black warning poles. (8) On a traditional wooden porch, the man, now in a black t-shirt, sits on a bench and uses his hands to carefully strip and segment the green stem of the lily. (9) He crafts the segments into a decorative necklace and places it around the neck of a woman wearing a pink athletic top who is sitting next to him. (10) The video concludes with a selfie-style shot of the man and woman smiling at the camera, with the man giving a thumbs up in front of the traditional house.

(2) A rhythmic, electronic chirping sound from a Japanese pedestrian signal is heard, mixed with the soft music. (3) The piano continues as the primary layer; a brief sound of trickling or splashing water occurs, suggesting a nearby stream. (4) A distinct, metallic 'ding-ding' sound of a railroad crossing alarm rings out repeatedly, indicating a change in location. (5) A female voice speaks playfully with a conversational tone, followed by a male voice responding warmly with the word 'Secret' and a light laugh. (6) Several short, percussive snapping or clicking sounds are audible as the man works on the plant stem. (7) The clip ends with pleasant vocalizations and laughter between the two individuals over the persistent, gentle piano BGM.
